posters.title: Association Between Mental Health and Overweight/Obesity Among Reproductive Women in Chattogram Division: A Cross-Sectional Study
posters.summary: Cross-sectional study of 405 reproductive-aged women using DASS-21; depression was significantly associated with overweight/obesity (OR 1.776, 95% CI 1.142–2.762).

content.text: Md Rezaul Mia, Md. Faisal Ahmed, Maharaj Khan Muna, Muhammad Shahariar, Rim Dilower. Presented at the Nutrition Summit 2025, organized by the Institute of Nutrition and Food Science, University of Dhaka.

content.caption: Poster (page 1) and published abstract (page 2), Nutrition Summit 2025.

sections.heading: Major predictive factors of obesity in women in Bangladesh

content.alt: Percentage of participants by (a) body mass index status, (b) depression, (c) anxiety and (d) stress status.

posters.title: Health Hazards Among E-waste Recyclers in Chattogram City, Bangladesh: A Cross-Sectional Analysis of Workplace Safety and Chronic Conditions
posters.summary: Survey of 84 e-waste workers in Chattogram City Corporation: burning and dismantling were significantly linked to cuts and burns, skin problems and red, itchy eyes; no link was found between heavy metal exposure and chronic illness.

content.text: Maharaj Khan Muna, Muhammad Shahariar, Umme Laiba Raha, Dr. Alak Paul. Department of Geography and Environmental Studies, University of Chittagong.

posters.title: Evaluating the Major Causes of Carbon Emissions in Chittagong Port: An Overview
posters.summary: Secondary-data review of CO2, carbon monoxide and black carbon emissions from head trucks, container handling equipment and locomotives at Chittagong Port, with policy recommendations.

posters.title: Electricity Consumption and Sense of 'Environment' in Everyday Practice: A Cross-Sectional Study in Bangladesh
posters.summary: Household questionnaire survey of 300 respondents across all eight divisions on electricity use, appliance choice and environmental awareness, analyzed with chi-square tests.
